_status: PROVISIONAL. Copy setup now matches the user (instant Telegram copy bot, ~$20 bankroll); quality gates still placeholders until the criteria from the transcripts are agreed.

prescreen._about: Cheap gates on GMGN leaderboard stats, used only to choose which wallets get a full history pull and backtest.

backtest._about: Generic copy model. The profile named in `bot` overrides these with that bot's real costs and guards.

copyfomo._about: Telegram bot copying fomo traders (SOL + Robinhood chain + Base + BNB). 2% per buy and per sell (docs, hidden since 2026-09-08: confirm on the bot's confirmation screen), network cost passed through, copies from $3. maxChase / minTraderBuyUsd are its settings; values are provisional until validated out of sample.

gmgn._about: GMGN copy trade: any Solana wallet, max 10. 1% per buy and per sell plus a priority fee you set (0.001 SOL ~ $0.12 here). No max-chase guard.

final._about: Gates on the wallet's own reconstructed history and on the copy backtest at `delayForGates` seconds.
